description.zh: 音频ID。可通过点播控制台查询音频ID或通过[SearchMedia](~~86044~~)接口请求后会返回音频ID。
description.en: The audio ID. You can query the audio ID in the video-on-demand console or obtain the audio ID from the response to a call of the [SearchMedia](~~86044~~) operation.

description.zh: 分页号。可选填，不填则返回所有结果不分页。
description.en: The page number. This parameter is optional. If you leave this parameter empty, all results are returned without paging.

title.zh: 获取智能音频审核结果详情

descriptions.zh:
### 使用说明
<props="china">智能审核处理完成后，配置了[智能审核完成](~~89576~~)的事件通知，则会通过消息回调方式通知回调URL，可调用本接口查询音频审核结果详情。</props>

<props="intl">
- 本接口仅支持新加坡地域。
- 智能审核处理完成后，配置了[智能审核完成](~~89576~~)的事件通知，则会通过消息回调方式通知回调URL，可调用本接口查询音频审核结果详情。</props>
descriptions.en:
### Usage notes

<props="china">

After the automated review is complete, if you have configured event notifications for [Automated review complete](~~89576~~), a message callback is sent to the specified URL. You can then call this operation to query the details of the audio audit result.

</props>

<props="intl">

- This operation is supported only in the Singapore region.
- After the automated review is complete, if you have configured event notifications for [Automated review complete](~~89576~~), a message callback is sent to the specified URL. You can then call this operation to query the details of the audio audit result.

</props>
